programmes.d: Lucy & Martin travel to Essex to see a house currently designed as two flats but can someone squeeze in any more? Then it's on to Derby to see a colourful two bedroom house and there's also a flat up for auction in Dover.
Martin and Lucy view properties in Derby, Wiltshire and Wales.
Martin & Lucy visit a one bedroomed house in Yorkshire, a two bedroom flat in Kent and a semi detached house in Birmingham.
Martin and Lucy view an end-of-terrace in Cornwall, a barn in Cheshire and a flat in Middlesex.
Martin and Lucy visit a bungalow in Derby, a London property that dates back to Victorian times, and a South Wales terrace.
Martin and Lucy visit a three bed Semi in Shropshire, a different sort of property in the Kent countryside and a terrace in Derby with features you won't want to keep.

Lucy and Martin visit a cottage in Grewelthorpe, Yorkshire, a stunning Victorian house with space in Yelverton, Devon and a former library in Middleton, Manchester which looks okay from the outside but you can't judge a book by its cover!
Martin & Lucy visit a three bed terraced property in Accrington, Lancashire, a property in need of full scale renovation in Kent and a barn in Devon.
Martin and Lucy visit a property in Stockport, there's a Maidstone office with planning permission for six flats and finally a Telford house with some easy renovation opportunities
Martin & Lucy visit a cottage in Devon, a converted terraced property in London and a house in Leeds.
Martin and Lucy visit a property in Preston, a property in Southsea and a terraced house near Durham with a surprise.
Martin & Lucy visit a confined ground floor flat in Wiltshire, a cottage in Kent and a plot of land in Yorkshire.

Martin and Lucy visit a grand farm house worth getting excited about in Cheshire, in Dorset there's an old wooden chapel praying for help from above and in Stoke there's a spacious semi with no space.
Martin and Lucy visit a three bedroom semi detached house in Nottingham, a Georgian terraced house in London and a workshop in Devon.

Lucy and Martin visit a grand block of flats in Herne Bay with views of the sea. They also take a look at a bungalow in Derbyshire with enough space to build a second property and a Georgian property in Preston with four floors in need of a makeover.
Martin and Lucy visit a lovely property in Yorkshire, a great development plot in Kingston with an access problem, and a semi detached house in Cornwall.
Martin Roberts and Lucy Alexander view properties in Wiltshire, Devon and Ramsgate.
Martin and Lucy visit a property in Wales, a top floor flat in London which could be a little ray of sunshine and a Ramsgate property that doesn't look all it's crack up to be.
Martin & Lucy visit a property in Plymouth, a house in London and a semi in Staffordshire.
Martin and Lucy visit a building plot in Warminster, a Victorian house in Selkirk and a top floor flat in Faversham.
Martin and Lucy view properties Gwent, West Sussex and Liverpool.
